description: Milo Manara (born September 12, 1945, in Luson, Italy) is a renowned Italian comic book artist celebrated for his sensual and elegant style. Initially trained in fine arts and architecture, he transitioned to comics in the late 1960s, drawn by their accessibility and narrative potential. Manara gained international fame with erotic works like Click and The Decameron , and collaborated with legendary figures such as Hugo Pratt ( Indian Summer ) and Federico Fellini ( Trip to Tulum ).
